value.rationale: Converts a recent published single counterexample to Poisson ultra-log-concavity into a complete sharp open-aperture classification, one equality boundary and precise index-local failure, while showing why the stronger binomial normalization cannot hold anywhere in that family. This is a natural exact quantitative stability regime for conic intrinsic-volume distributions, not an arbitrary isolated parameter computation.
